description: This Java class 'SaleDBUtil' provides utility methods for managing sale-related database operations within the project, including fetching sales, updating statuses, creating sales, and retrieving sale details.

classes.name: SaleDBUtil
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for sale-related database operations such as retrieval, creation, and updates.

methods.name: getAllSales
methods.description: Retrieves all sale records along with related payment, feedback, and customer data from the database.

methods.name: UpdateEmID
methods.description: Updates the employee ID associated with a sale, indicating acceptance to deliver.

methods.name: UpdateStatus
methods.description: Updates the order status and payment status after delivery completion.

methods.name: createSale
methods.description: Creates a new sale record in the database after payment completion and returns the generated sale ID.

methods.name: getSaleDetailsByOrderID
methods.description: Fetches detailed sale information consolidated with customer and cart product details for a specific order ID.
